review_scope: Registered-source content review of arXiv:2203.00837v4, stamped 23 December 2023, by Edward H. Kennedy, Sivaraman Balakrishnan, James M. Robins and Larry Wasserman. The PDF has 48 pages. Main text and references end on physical page 29; only the Appendices heading at the top of page 30 was inspected. No appendix body was read. Fresh text evidence covers all 29 main-paper pages; original formulas, definitions, conventions and boundary pages were inspected visually.
inventory: Exactly two actual Theorem headings occur, Theorem 1 on page 5 and Theorem 2 on page 24. Both complete statements were compared with the rendered PDF. Propositions, remarks, citations and appendix results are excluded.
original_statements: Theorem 1 preserves its interior target point, four model restrictions, average nuisance smoothness, sufficiently-large-n qualifier, infimum over estimators, supremum over the model and both rate branches. The low-smoothness threshold is strict; its equality belongs to the otherwise branch. No overlap, local density lower bound or proposed-estimator requirements are inserted.

Theorem 2 preserves all regularity conditions A-C, the approximation reference (6), the full density-ratio condition and its denominator, overlap, three smoothness restrictions, both bandwidth/dimension choices and the mean absolute-error bound. The unparenthesized maximum in the rate denominator and lower bound on a sup norm remain literal. The conclusion does not add a supremum over the broad lower-bound model.
source_passages: All 12 source entries and 10 auxiliary passages were checked. The iid observed triples, covariate law, conditional functions, observed regression-contrast target and strict-floor Hölder class match page 4. Causal identification assumptions from page 2 remain separate from the statistical target. The average smoothness abbreviation and model limitations match page 5.

Definition 2 matches pages 15-16 in full across its component entries: the shifted Legendre formula, total-degree dimension, localized kernel, separate k-dimensional basis, independently trained nuisance inputs, estimated Gram matrix, estimator aggregation and four correction kernels. Ordered U-statistic pairs and the first-order raw-A treatment factor are retained.

The weighted population projection, Q and R match page 16. The local transformed measure, basis projection and approximation condition match page 18, with the coordinate projection and integration-domain convention on pages 19-20. The inferred population Gram interpretation is explicitly distinguished from a separately printed definition.

The independent training convention, warning against an ordinary empirical covariate estimator, source X1-versus-X2 correction mismatch, gamma-versus-beta prose, comparison symbols and third-order remainder were checked against their main-text passages. These supporting passages do not turn proof requirements into theorem dependencies.
dependency_review: All 14 direct uses and 16 related connections were checked, including all 12 reach sets and every reported path. Only the observed-data model, conditional functions, CATE target and Hölder class reach both theorems. The two bases, trained nuisances, higher-order estimator, population projection, transformed measure and approximation condition reach only Theorem 2. No lower-bound proof construction, appendix submodel, proposition or alternative marginal-regression model is imported.
names_and_highlights: Every interface retains source natural-language keywords and original labels or passage headings. All selectors were checked against original formulas or related same-paper statements. Definition 2 is retained across its component passages, and condition (6) remains an approximation condition. The local basis naming context and population projection coordinate context have their own evidence.
source_limitations: The 23 existing notes were checked. They preserve strict-floor smoothness; lower-bound identifiability limitations; the unstated smoothness ordering; ball/cube and transformed-measure normalization inconsistencies; the X1/X2 correction mismatch; raw-A and control-regression choices; implicit population Gram identification; a sup-norm lower bound versus pointwise domination; maximum precedence and zero denominator; fixed-factor versus smaller-order language; independent training scope; nuisance construction and singularity limitations; randomness of boundedness conditions; suppressed stretched compositions; different basis dimensions; integer tuning; distinct lower/upper model scope; causal interpretation; excluded marginal-regression results; and defective proposition/condition references. Source fidelity does not certify correctness of the printed results.
changes: No census-content correction was required. The per-paper rebuild now resolves the fixed verified local PDF. Earlier scripts are archived; the original audit and all six extracted JSON artifacts remain unchanged.
validation: Independent inventory and census validators pass, and all six regenerated artifacts match saved bytes. Source identity, exact heading enumeration, main-text endpoint, graph sets, selectors and artifact hashes supplement the completed manual source review.
